Device.Name: EM1430 (32DI P/N)
EM1430 (32DI P/N)
Device.Comment: 32DI; eight optional P2n/P3n counter slots. PUL, AB, DIRPUL, CWCCW; 32-bit hardware counters. Empty slots by default. Mode follows PDO assignment. Filter/reverse/edges via CoE.
32路DI；8个默认空计数槽，端子顺序P2n/P3n。PUL、AB、DIRPUL、CWCCW，32位硬件计数。Slot决定模式，CoE配置滤波、反向和边沿。
